scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

review_method: 25 whole-frame and5 face samples viewed; rejected without needing all-thumbnail review or continuous playback.
observations: Actual front-to-profile then back-facing around2-3s, return front by4.25s, rather than requested25-35degree shallow turn. Background broadly fixed and front wardrobe recognizable in reviewed samples, but back design not verified.
retry_reason: Simplify to one small front-three-quarter stance and hold; no return-turn sequence. Same approved still and character. One retry maximum.
final_review_observations: Actual turn exposes unverified back atabout2-3s; source excluded, not recycled in final film.
